stories.story_fr: Le ratio combine de la reassurance Dommages se degrade a 83,9% au T1 2025 (vs 69,7%), penalise par un ratio de sinistres majeurs de 21,3%, reflet d'une charge de catastrophes plus elevee.
stories.story_en: The P&C reinsurance combined ratio worsens to 83.9% in Q1 2025 (vs 69.7%), hurt by a major-loss ratio of 21.3%, reflecting a higher catastrophe burden.

stories.story_fr: La reassurance Vie et Sante (L&H) progresse avec un resultat technique de 608 M€ au T1 2025 (vs 484 M€), compensant en partie la pression sur les activites Dommages.
stories.story_en: Life & Health reinsurance (L&H) advances with a technical result of EUR 608 million in Q1 2025 (vs EUR 484 million), partly offsetting pressure on P&C.
stories.quote: L&H: Total technical result: €608m (€484m) – net result: €501m (€487m)
